decision.explanation: All four candidates are directly supported by the source text segments. D1S1 ('focusing on orca research') supports 'orca researcher'. D1S5 ('Visser works as a guide on a variety of eco-tourism adventures') supports 'eco-tourism guide'. D1S6 ('She is also a public speaker') supports 'public speaker'. D1S3 ('Visser has written an autobiography... and two children's books') supports 'author'. The prior audit J_A marked C0 as 'uncertain', but D1S1 explicitly describes her work focus, validating the profession. All four represent distinct, valid professions held by Ingrid Visser according to the text.
